items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: And Attorney Robert Carr, who was the president of the corporation, took it to court and challenged it, and we won the case.

ctx.x: Well, there were certain establishments downtown that wanted 24 hour service, as far as entertainment and all that stuff. When I say entertainment, I don't mean musical. I mean wanted the people to spend their
money at their bars, you know, or either upstairs. And Attorney Robert Carr, who was the president of the corporation, took it to court and challenged it, and we won the case.
I remember there was -- I think I remember there were petitions going around, weren't there? Because I can remember signing some petitions.
